title: Sir Gawain, Lines 208–231
subtitle: Arthur responds; Gawain volunteers.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Bot Arthur wolde not ete til al were serued... Close reading of the social dynamics and the chivalric code. Arthur will not eat until all are served. Gawain steps forward to take the challenge. Honor, courtesy, and the test of the hero.
